scripts.test: bash scripts/container.sh docker.io/library/node:24 npx --no-install vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.coverage: bash scripts/container.sh docker.io/library/node:24 npx --no-install vitest run --coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:node && npm run lint:dotnet
scripts.lint:dotnet: bash scripts/container.sh mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 dotnet build tools/complexity-fixture --nologo

scripts.typecheck: bash scripts/container.sh docker.io/library/node:24 npx --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.json
